findings.claim: Object/person uses cross direction-only exclusion families. A bare こっち question can offer both intended сюда and это; этот предмет, although its adopted meaning includes этот вариант. あっち includes object selection, making вон то a valid alternative. Existing pairs cover place/direction but not ordinary object/person readings.
findings.evidence: Full source/RU articles; dictionary families 1004500 senses 3/5, 1483185 senses 2/3, 1006780 senses 3/5, 1000580 sense 2. Russian это does not encode Japanese proximity; этот человек does not encode politeness. Extra dictionary person senses justify quiz protection, not an expansion requirement.
findings.remedy: Add the identified direct pairs or make labels demonstrably disjoint while retaining valid meanings. No transitive closure implied.
findings.confidence: High for object overlaps; medium-high for person-label overlaps.

findings.claim: Modifier labels remain compatible with unrestricted demonstrative labels. Этот (перед существительным) does not uniquely separate この from その: the latter translates その映画 as Этот фильм. Unrestricted Russian это/то have attributive uses; qualifying only one competing label does not make the other interpretation false.
findings.evidence: Actual labels/examples and frozen entries 1582920/1006830, sense 1. This is Russian-label ambiguity, not interchangeability of Japanese standalone and modifying forms.
findings.remedy: Direct exclusions or explicit mutually discriminating standalone/modifier and reference qualifications.
findings.confidence: High for この–その; medium-high for other label-level pairs.

findings.claim: Unrestricted selection labels overlap どの. Который из нескольких and который из двух describe selection meanings also available to どの. Those labels do not restrict themselves to standalone use; only どの's label supplies the syntactic qualification.
findings.evidence: Frozen どの article's understood selection set; JMdict 1920240 sense 1 and 1189360 sense 2. No size restriction excludes two alternatives from どの.
findings.remedy: Add the three direct exclusions or explicitly disambiguate standalone versus noun-modifying labels.
